senses.gloss: (cmp. חָשָׁה) [to whisper,] to suspect (cmp. דּוּם a. דִּימָה).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 19b">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>החוֹשֵׁד בכשרים</he> he who entertains a suspicion against worthy men.
<cite ref="Yoma 19b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>חֲשָׁדוּהוּ</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>צדוקי</he> they suspected him of being a Sadducee.
<cite ref="Shabbat 127b:4">Sabb. 127ᵇ</cite> <he>במה חֲשַׁדְתַּנִי</he> whereof did you suspect me?—

<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:8">Ib. 118ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:19">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שחוֹשְׁדִין וכ׳</he> whom people suspect without cause; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>חָשׁוּד</he>, f. <he>חֲשׁוּדָה</he>; pl. <he>חֲשׁוּדִים</he>, <he>חֲשׁוּדִין</he>; <he>חֲשׁוּדוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 69a:10">Erub. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ לדבר אחד ח׳ וכ׳</he> one who is suspected of neglecting one religious law, is suspected of disregarding the whole Law; <cite ref="Bekhorot 30b">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 30a:3">Ib. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ על השביעית</he> suspected of ignoring the laws of the Sabbatical year.
<cite ref="Shevuot 32b">Shebu. 32ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ח׳ על השבועה</he> suspected of swearing falsely (not admitted to oaths).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:1:3">Y. Taan. III, beg. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני פרנסת ח׳</he> for the sustenance of those suspected (of neglecting the laws of the Sabbatical year); a. fr.

<cite ref="Berakhot 31b">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 1:16">I Sam. I, 16</cite>) <he>מבאן לנ׳ בדבר וכ׳</he> from this we learn that he who is unjustly suspected, must make it known (clear himself).

<cite ref="Bekhorot 30b">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:16">Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיֵחָשְׁדוּ</he> until there is reason to suspect them of neglecting the observances of the associates (v. <cite ref="H00109"><he>חָבֵר</he></cite>); a. fr.—[Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ <he>מתחשד</he>, v. <cite ref="H01806"><he>חָשַׁב</he></cite>.]
